top_findings.title: POST /books not exposed by the served app
top_findings.evidence: main.py declares only @app.get('/health') (main.py:22) and @app.get('/books') (main.py:26); no @app.post. create_book() at book_api.py:24 exists but book_api is never imported by main.py and is bound to no router.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an @app.post('/books', status_code=201) route in main.py that validates and persists a book.

top_findings.title: GET /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
top_findings.evidence: No @app.get('/books/{id}') in main.py. get_book_by_id() at book_api.py:57 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an @app.get('/books/{book_id}') route returning one book (404 if absent).

top_findings.title: PUT /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
top_findings.evidence: No @app.put in main.py. update_book() at book_api.py:70 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an @app.put('/books/{book_id}') route that updates an existing book.

top_findings.title: DELETE /books/{id} not exposed by the served app
top_findings.evidence: No @app.delete in main.py. delete_book() at book_api.py:114 is unrouted and book_api is not imported.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an @app.delete('/books/{book_id}', status_code=204) route that deletes a book.

top_findings.title: No input validation (title/author required) in the served API
top_findings.evidence: main.py has no POST route and no Pydantic model; the served app never validates input. The NOT NULL constraint at book_api.py:15 is never reached over HTTP and yields no 400.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a Pydantic request model (title/author required) to the POST route so invalid input returns 422/400.
